body: **Foco:** Participle clause — forma.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** e-mail, carta, mensagem.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo formar orações participiais (presente, passado e perfeito) para ligar ideias em e-mails formais.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.subject: Application for the data analyst position
paras: **Having read** your advertisement in the Daily Courier, I am writing to apply for the data analyst position. **Working** for three years in a research institute, I developed skills in statistics and reporting. **Trained** in two software packages, I can start quickly.
**Not having worked** abroad, I am eager to learn. **Encouraged** by my supervisor, I have enclosed a recommendation. **Hoping** to hear from you, I remain available for an interview.

items.q: Inês is writing to apply for a job.
items.why: apply for the data analyst position.

blocks.body: O **sujeito** da oração participial deve ser o **mesmo** da oração principal. Participiais tornam o texto mais **compacto e formal**.
✗ *Having read your ad, the job interests me.* ✓ *Having read your ad, I am interested.*

items.s: ___ read your advertisement, I am writing to apply. (Having)
___ for three years, I developed skills. (Working)
___ in two software packages, I can start quickly. (Trained)
___ having worked abroad, I am eager to learn. (Not)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Good Is the subject the same
items.pt: Bom. O sujeito é o mesmo?

body: **I remain at your disposal.** — Fico à sua disposição.
**I am eager to…** — Estou ansioso para…
**I would welcome the opportunity to…** — Eu receberia bem a oportunidade de…
**Please find enclosed…** — Segue em anexo…
**Having said that,…** — Dito isso,…
**As requested,…** — Conforme solicitado,…
**At your convenience** — Quando lhe for conveniente
**Look forward to a favourable reply** — Aguardar uma resposta favorável
**Check your first sentence.** — Verifique sua primeira frase.
**Good. Is the subject the same?** — Bom. O sujeito é o mesmo?
**Yes: I read, and I am writing.** — Sim: eu li, e eu escrevo.

Trained in statistics, I can start quickly.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence cover email with at least four participial clauses.
blocks.model: Having seen your advertisement, I am writing to apply for the post of editor. Working as a translator for five years, I have learned to meet deadlines. Trained in two editing programs, I can start immediately. Not having worked in publishing, I am eager to learn. Encouraged by my teachers, I enclose two references. Hoping to hear from you, I remain at your disposal.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
